## Architecture Configurations

**Basic:** Single deployment + PostgreSQL [9]

**Advanced (Queue Mode):** UI/API deployment + worker deployment + PostgreSQL +
Redis [9]

## Queue Mode

Queue mode distributes workflow execution via Redis using BullMQ [3][49]:

| Component | Role | Source |
|-----------|------|--------|
| Main instance | Handles UI, API, webhooks; enqueues jobs | [9] |
| Workers | Pull from Redis, execute workflows | [9][49] |
| Redis | Job queue backend (BullMQ) | [3][49] |
| PostgreSQL | Required for queue mode (SQLite incompatible) | [50] |

Configuration:
- `EXECUTIONS_MODE=queue` on main instance [9][52]
- Workers deployed as separate n8n instances with `worker` command [9]
- Configurable concurrency per worker [49]
- Workers scale independently based on load [9]

## Database Backends

| Database | Status | Notes | Source |
|----------|--------|-------|--------|
| SQLite | Default | Testing only; file locking, no hot backups, no queue mode | [32][50] |
| PostgreSQL | Production | 13+ required, 15 recommended | [32] |
| MySQL/MariaDB | Deprecated | Removed as of v1.0 | [32] |

## Security Model

### Credential Encryption
- All credentials encrypted using N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY with AES256 [33][48]
- Key auto-generated on first launch; must be manually set for production [48]
- Minimum 32 characters, hex format [9]

### n8n Cloud Security
- Azure server-side disk encryption (AES256, FIPS-140-2 compliant) [33]

### Authentication
- Email/password [59]
- LDAP [59]
- SAML SSO (Enterprise plan) [59]
- Optional 2FA [59]

### RBAC
- Available on paid plans [34]
- Group workflows into projects with role-based access [34]
- Role types, projects, and custom roles [34]

### External Secrets
- HashiCorp Vault integration (Enterprise) [35]
- AWS Secrets Manager (Enterprise) [35]

## Environment Variables

Configuration via environment variables or configuration file [52]:
- `_FILE` suffix support for Docker/Kubernetes secrets [52]
- Key variables: `DB_TYPE`, `EXECUTIONS_MODE`, `N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY`,
  `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL` [52]
- `N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true` for task runners [9]

## Backup and Recovery

**n8n Cloud:** Automated backups, professional maintenance, rapid recovery [45]

**Self-hosted:**
- User responsible for backup implementation [44]
- CLI export: `n8n export:workflow --all`, `n8n export:credentials --all` [44]
- Recommended tools: Restic, BorgBackup for incremental backups [44]
- Cost: $5-10/month implementation, $2-5/month off-site storage [44]

## Monitoring

- Native Prometheus metrics support [36]
- Community Grafana dashboards available [36]
- Key metrics: CPU, memory, heap usage, GC, event loop, queue length, active
  executions, workflow execution times, error rates [36]
- Alert examples: high memory (>80% for 5 min), high CPU (>80% for 5 min) [36]

## n8n Cloud vs Self-Hosted

| Aspect | Cloud | Self-Hosted |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| Starting price | $24/month (2,500 executions) [9] | Free software + $5-10/month infra [9] |
| Execution caps | Per plan [9] | None [15] |
| Break-even | Below ~20,000 exec/month [44] | Above ~20,000 exec/month [44] |
| Backups | Automated [45] | User responsibility [44] |
| Updates | Automatic [45] | Manual [44] |
| Data sovereignty | Azure cloud [33] | Full control [44] |
| SSO/RBAC | Included in plans [34] | Enterprise license required [34] |
